package.name: Workshop Make
package.description: Getting a part made: setups and specs, a printability check and a pass/fix verdict, mass as printed, slicing, fits and hardware holes sized for your printer, screw threads from the standards, and parts encased mid-print (nuts, magnets, bearings, inserts) with the pauses to drop them in. A Python API (workshop_make.api); tools for agents through Agent Link when it is installed.
